node.title: Re^3: @INC error
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Tried that.

I think it'd be best if you showed us exactly what you tried, because the output you're showing here just shows that some of the entries in [doc://@INC] got duplicated, not that the path /usr/local/share/perl5 got added to [doc://@INC] like we suggested. And [id://11111447|as I said], in [man://cron], you'll have to set up the environment variables yourself. If you could explain more about your setup (like whether you're actually using [doc://local::lib] or not, and how the module ended up where it did, what commands you're actually trying, etc.), we could be of more help.
